info.title: Contactzilla API
info.description: Contacts, address books, labels and fields in Contactzilla. Authenticate with OAuth 2 (authorization code with PKCE) or a personal access token; every endpoint lists the scopes it needs.

tags.name: You and your teams
tags.description: Who the token belongs to, and the teams and address books it can reach.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Listing, reading and changing contacts in an address book.

tags.name: Labels
tags.description: Labels on contacts and the labels an address book has.

tags.name: Fields and custom fields
tags.description: The field catalogue every contact is built from, and custom fields.

get.description: Pages of 50, newest changes included when you pass updated_since — the way to sync incrementally. Hidden contacts are omitted unless preset_filter=hiddencontacts (administrators only).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search across names, company and details.

parameters.name: labels_match
parameters.description: Whether a contact needs one of the labels (default) or all of them.

parameters.name: preset_filter
parameters.description: nolabels, noemail, nophone, noaddress, nobio, or hiddencontacts.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Only contacts changed at or after this moment, e.g. 2026-09-23T10:00:00Z.

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: exclude (default) leaves deleted contacts out; include returns live and deleted ones (deleted_at is set on the latter); only returns just the deleted ones. Pair with updated_since to pick up deletions when syncing.
